responsibility: Implements the main rs6000/PowerPC target backend. This is the central file for ABI and calling-convention logic, stack frame and prologue/epilogue generation, address legitimacy and reload support, constant and TOC handling, assembly output helpers, builtin expansion, vector and scalar lowering helpers, atomic and synchronization expansion, option-dependent target hooks, and miscellaneous target-specific optimization support, culminating in the targetm hook initializer that binds the backend into GCC.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C implementation of the rs6000 backend, containing the target hook code and helper routines that realize ABI handling, expansion, and assembly support. Unlike powerpcspe.h, it is not the macro interface, unlike powerpcspe.md it is not the RTL pattern file, and unlike powerpcspe.opt it is not the option table.
